idm-001956.m: Adapt to the customs of the place you visit.
idm-001956.e: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.

idm-001957.m: Determination can help you find a solution.
idm-001957.e: Where there's a will, there's a way.

idm-001958.m: You cannot enjoy two mutually incompatible advantages.
idm-001958.e: You can't have your cake and eat it too.

idm-001960.m: Trying to please everyone may prevent genuine loyalty.
idm-001960.e: A friend to all is a friend to none.

idm-001961.m: Starting well helps you finish well.
idm-001961.e: A good beginning makes a good ending.

idm-001962.m: Limited knowledge can lead to dangerous overconfidence.
idm-001962.e: A little learning is a dangerous thing.

idm-001963.m: A near failure is still a failure.
idm-001963.e: A miss is as good as a mile.

idm-001964.m: A friendly request to hear what someone is thinking.

idm-001965.m: Saving money is as valuable as earning it.
idm-001965.e: A penny saved is a penny earned.

idm-001966.m: A gentle response can calm anger.
idm-001966.e: A soft answer turns away wrath.

idm-001967.m: A sensible person needs only a brief warning.
idm-001967.e: A word to the wise is enough.

idm-001968.m: Those who know least sometimes speak the loudest.
idm-001968.e: An empty vessel makes the most sound.

idm-001969.m: A small precaution can prevent a larger problem.
idm-001969.e: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.

idm-001970.m: You must accept the consequences of your choices.
idm-001970.e: As you make your bed, so you must lie on it.

idm-001972.m: People dependent on help cannot always demand their preferred option.

idm-001973.m: A saying that excuses boys’ mischievous behavior.

idm-001974.e: Charity covers a multitude of sins.

idm-001975.m: Cleanliness is regarded as morally important.

idm-001976.m: Avoiding unnecessary danger can be wiser than fighting.
idm-001976.e: Discretion is the better part of valor.

idm-001977.m: Do not offer valuable things to people unable to appreciate them.

idm-001978.m: Do not criticize the quality of a gift.
idm-001978.e: Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.

idm-001979.m: Even a patient person will eventually resist mistreatment.

idm-001980.m: Each person must look after their own interests.

idm-001981.m: Fine promises are useless without action.

idm-001982.m: People are served in the order they arrive.

idm-001983.m: Knowing about danger in advance helps you prepare.

idm-001984.m: Effort and initiative matter when seeking help or success.
idm-001984.e: God helps those who help themselves.

idm-001985.m: Clear boundaries help preserve good relationships.

idm-001986.m: Having something is better than having nothing.
idm-001986.e: Half a loaf is better than none.

idm-001987.m: Delaying may cost you an opportunity.

idm-001988.m: Hope for a good outcome while preparing for difficulties.
idm-001988.e: Hope for the best, prepare for the worst.

idm-001989.m: If you cannot defeat a group, consider cooperating with it.
idm-001989.e: If you can't beat them, join them.

idm-001990.m: Do something yourself if you want to control its quality.
idm-001990.e: If you want a thing done well, do it yourself.

idm-001991.m: Once committed, be prepared to follow through fully.
idm-001991.e: In for a penny, in for a pound.

idm-001992.m: Even a bad event usually benefits someone.
idm-001992.e: It's an ill wind that blows no good.

idm-001993.m: It is never too late to improve or correct your behavior.
idm-001993.e: It's never too late to mend.

idm-001994.m: Knowledge gives people ability and influence.

idm-001995.m: A dispute may resolve sooner if people stop discussing it.

idm-001997.m: Your choices and actions shape your life.
idm-001997.e: Life is what you make it.

idm-001998.m: A son often resembles his father.

idm-001999.m: Accept others’ choices while living as you choose.

idm-002000.m: Unhappy people often find comfort in others who share their troubles.
